Our successful team consisted of A.Penny (2), C.T.Carter (6), H.E.Footer (7), A.Allum (8). Unfortunately, this excellent start was not maintained, for in the 4 x 440 yards race held at Deptford Park on May 20th, we finished last of the six clubs.
H.E.Footer seemed to have put the cares of captaincy aside for one evening and I understand that on this occasion the moral to be preached was " Don't do as I do, etc.
